verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a library that also ships a Dockerized FastAPI server, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, changelog guarantees, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every path tried, so there is no published versioned API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
